title: An untracked part shows Not Tracked with its bins, Min and Max in the list
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active untracked part, part A, with 4 in bin location A, 3 in bin location B, and a saved Min of 2 and Max of 6.
  • Make sure the Bin Location / Quantity, Total Qty, Min and Max columns are switched on in the columns button.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps: 1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's Total Qty cell reads "Not Tracked" in grey, with no quantity badge.
  • Its Bin Location / Quantity cell still shows both bins with their quantities: bin location A with 4 and bin location B with 3.
  • Its Min cell reads 2 and its Max cell reads 6.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part)

  • S4-R8: “An untracked part shows "Not Tracked" in the Inventory list's Total Qty column instead of a quantity.”
  • S4-R8a: “On the Inventory list, an untracked part's Bin Location / Quantity column still shows each bin with its quantity.”
  • S4-R8b: “On the Inventory list, an untracked part's Min and Max columns still show the saved values.”
  • Feature Overview, Core functionality: “An untracked part is not counted. The Inventory list shows "Not Tracked" instead of its total quantity, and its Min and Max are kept but not used. Its bins and their quantities stay on screen as a shelf reference. It can still be used on work orders and invoices.”
